```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoo)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(Metrics)
library(forecast)
library(randomForest)
library(pdp)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# Load data & create targets
# -------------------------
data = read.csv("../data/data_merged.csv")
data_mean = read.csv("../data/prevail_mean.csv")

data$date <- as.Date(data$date)
data_mean$date <- as.Date(data_mean$date)

# ============================================================================
# CREATE MULTI-HORIZON TARGET VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
# We want to forecast 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month ahead returns
# 6-month = sum of 2 consecutive quarters
# 12-month = sum of 4 consecutive quarters

data <- data %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create lead log returns for each horizon
    log_ret_lead_3m = lead(log_ret, 1),           # 3-month ahead (1 quarter)
    log_ret_lead_6m = lead(log_ret, 1) + lead(log_ret, 2),  # 6-month ahead (2 quarters)
    log_ret_lead_12m = lead(log_ret, 1) + lead(log_ret, 2) + lead(log_ret, 3) + lead(log_ret, 4)  # 12-month ahead (4 quarters)
  )

# ============================================================================
# CREATE LAGGED VARIABLES FOR MULTI-HORIZON TARGETS
# ============================================================================
# Create 5 lags for each horizon's returns

# Lags for 3-month returns
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    log_ret_3m_L1 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 1),
    log_ret_3m_L2 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 2),
    log_ret_3m_L3 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 3),
    log_ret_3m_L4 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 4),
    log_ret_3m_L5 = lag(log_ret_lead_3m, 5)
  )

# ============================================================================
# SELECT FINAL FEATURES FOR MODELING
# ============================================================================

data <- data %>%
  select(
    date,
    log_ret,
    # Multi-horizon targets
    log_ret_lead_3m,
    log_ret_lead_6m,
    log_ret_lead_12m,
    # All lagged y's (multi-horizon targets at various lags)
    matches("^log_ret_3m_L"),
    # Lagged x's from original data (L2-L5 only to avoid leakage)
    matches("^price_fd_L[1-5]$"),
    matches("_L[2-5]$")
  ) %>% drop_na()

cat("\n=== Multi-Horizon Target Variables Created ===\n")
cat("✓ log_ret_lead_3m: 3-month ahead returns (1 quarter)\n")
cat("✓ log_ret_lead_6m: 6-month ahead returns (sum of 2 quarters)\n")
cat("✓ log_ret_lead_12m: 12-month ahead returns (sum of 4 quarters)\n")
cat("✓ 5 lags created for each horizon\n")
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# RF multi-horizon pipeline with 80/20 STATIC SPLIT
# -------------------------

horizons <- list(
  h1 = list(name = "3m",  steps = 1, target_col = "log_ret_lead_3m"),
  h2 = list(name = "6m",  steps = 2, target_col = "log_ret_lead_6m"),
  h4 = list(name = "12m", steps = 4, target_col = "log_ret_lead_12m")
)

rf_results_all <- list()
rf_evals_all   <- list()
rf_models <- list()
set.seed(123)

# helper: impute numeric (median) and factor (mode) from training -> apply to test
impute_train_test <- function(X_train, X_test) {
  X_train <- X_train %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  X_test  <- X_test  %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
  num_cols <- names(X_train)[sapply(X_train, is.numeric)]
  for (col in num_cols) {
    med <- median(X_train[[col]], na.rm = TRUE); if (is.na(med)) med <- 0
    X_train[[col]][is.na(X_train[[col]])] <- med
    X_test[[col]][is.na(X_test[[col]])]   <- med
  }
  fac_cols <- names(X_train)[sapply(X_train, is.factor)]
  for (col in fac_cols) {
    modev <- names(sort(table(X_train[[col]]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    if (is.na(modev)) modev <- levels(X_train[[col]])[1]
    X_train[[col]] <- addNA(X_train[[col]])
    X_train[[col]][is.na(X_train[[col]])] <- modev
    X_test[[col]] <- factor(X_test[[col]], levels = levels(X_train[[col]]))
    X_test[[col]][is.na(X_test[[col]])] <- modev
  }
  list(train = X_train, test = X_test)
}

for (h_key in names(horizons)) {
  info <- horizons[[h_key]]
  h_steps <- info$steps; tgt_col <- info$target_col; h_name <- info$name

  cat("\n=== RF: Horizon", h_name, "(lead", h_steps, "quarters) ===\n")

  df_h <- data %>% arrange(date) %>% select(date, log_ret, all_of(tgt_col), everything()) %>%
    rename(target = all_of(tgt_col)) %>% mutate(target_date = lead(date, h_steps)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(target) & !is.na(target_date))

  n <- nrow(df_h)
  if (n < 12) { cat("Not enough obs for", h_name, "- skipping\n"); next }

  # 80/20 split
  train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)
  test_size <- n - train_size
  train_data <- df_h[1:train_size, ]
  test_data <- df_h[(train_size+1):n, ]

  # exclude columns that are targets or created from leads
  leak_patterns <- c("^log_ret_3m_L", "^log_ret_6m_L", "^log_ret_12m_L", "^log_ret_lead")
  all_cols <- names(df_h)
  leak_cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(leak_patterns, function(p) grep(p, all_cols, value = TRUE))))
  safe_exclude <- c("date","log_ret","target","target_date", leak_cols, "mean_prevailing_ret")
  pred_cols <- setdiff(all_cols, safe_exclude)

  X_train_full <- train_data %>% select(all_of(pred_cols))
  X_test_full <- test_data %>% select(all_of(pred_cols))
  y_train_full <- train_data$target

  # impute by training stats
  imputed <- impute_train_test(X_train_full, X_test_full)
  X_train_full <- imputed$train
  X_test_full <- imputed$test

  # tuning grid (internal holdout)
  rf_param_grid <- expand.grid(
    mtry = unique(pmax(1, round(c(5, 10, 20, ncol(X_train_full)/2)))),
    nodesize = c(1,2,3,5),
    ntree = c(100,200)
  )
  
  tune_train_size <- floor(0.8 * train_size)
  X_tune_train <- X_train_full[1:tune_train_size, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tune_train <- y_train_full[1:tune_train_size]
  X_tune_val <- X_train_full[(tune_train_size+1):train_size, , drop = FALSE]
  y_tune_val <- y_train_full[(tune_train_size+1):train_size]

  best_val_rmse <- Inf; best_params_rf <- NULL; p <- ncol(X_tune_train)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rf_param_grid))) {
    mtry_i <- min(rf_param_grid$mtry[i], p)
    temp_rf <- randomForest(x = X_tune_train, y = y_tune_train,
                            ntree = rf_param_grid$ntree[i],
                            mtry = mtry_i,
                            nodesize = rf_param_grid$nodesize[i])
    val_preds <- predict(temp_rf, newdata = X_tune_val)
    val_rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_tune_val - val_preds)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (val_rmse < best_val_rmse) {
      best_val_rmse <- val_rmse
      best_params_rf <- rf_param_grid[i, ]
      best_params_rf$mtry <- mtry_i
    }
  }

  cat("Best params: mtry=", best_params_rf$mtry,
      "nodesize=", best_params_rf$nodesize, "ntree=", best_params_rf$ntree,
      "val_RMSE=", round(best_val_rmse,6), "\n")

  # Train final RF on full training set
  rf_final <- randomForest(x = X_train_full, y = y_train_full,
                           ntree = best_params_rf$ntree,
                           mtry = best_params_rf$mtry,
                           nodesize = best_params_rf$nodesize)

  # Predictions
  rf_train_preds <- predict(rf_final, newdata = X_train_full)
  rf_test_preds <- predict(rf_final, newdata = X_test_full)
  preds_all <- c(rf_train_preds, rf_test_preds)

  results_df <- df_h %>%
    mutate(actual = target, forecast = preds_all) %>%
    select(date, target_date, actual, forecast) %>%
    left_join(data_mean %>% select(date, mean_prevailing_ret), by = "date") %>%
    rename(mean_prevailing_pred = mean_prevailing_ret) %>%
    mutate(horizon = h_name)

  write_csv(results_df, paste0("../data/rf_results_h", h_name, ".csv"))

  eval_df <- results_df %>%
    slice((train_size+1):n) %>%
    mutate(err = actual - forecast, err_mean = actual - mean_prevailing_pred)

  rf_results_all[[paste0("h", h_name)]] <- results_df
  rf_evals_all[[paste0("h", h_name)]] <- eval_df

  actual_test <- eval_df$actual
  pred_test <- eval_df$forecast
  mean_test <- eval_df$mean_prevailing_pred

  MAE_rf <- mean(abs(actual_test - pred_test), na.rm = TRUE)
  RMSE_rf <- sqrt(mean((actual_test - pred_test)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  R2_rf <- if (length(na.omit(pred_test))>1) cor(actual_test, pred_test, use = "complete.obs")^2 else NA
  MAE_mean <- mean(abs(actual_test - mean_test), na.rm = TRUE)
  RMSE_mean <- sqrt(mean((actual_test - mean_test)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  R2_mean <- if (length(na.omit(mean_test))>1) cor(actual_test, mean_test, use = "complete.obs")^2 else NA

  cat("Test metrics (h=", h_name, "): RF MAE=", round(MAE_rf,6),
      "RMSE=", round(RMSE_rf,6), "R2=", round(R2_rf,4), "\n")
  cat("Prevailing mean: MAE=", round(MAE_mean,6), "RMSE=", round(RMSE_mean,6), "R2=", round(R2_mean,4), "\n")

  dm_res <- tryCatch({ dm.test(e1 = eval_df$err^2, e2 = eval_df$err_mean^2, alternative = "less") }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(dm_res)) cat("DM stat:", round(as.numeric(dm_res$statistic),3), "p-value:", signif(dm_res$p.value,4), "\n")

  plot_df <- eval_df %>% drop_na(target_date, actual, forecast, mean_prevailing_pred)
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = target_date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = actual, color = "Actual")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_prevailing_pred, color = "Prevailing mean")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = forecast, color = "RF forecast")) +
    labs(title = paste("RF 80/20 Split (h =", h_name, ")"),
         subtitle = paste0("Test set (n=", nrow(plot_df), ")"),
         x = "Date (target)", y = "Log return", color = "") + theme_minimal()
  print(p)
}

if (length(rf_results_all) > 0) write_csv(bind_rows(rf_results_all), "../data/rf_results_all_horizons.csv")
if (length(rf_evals_all)  > 0) write_csv(bind_rows(rf_evals_all),  "../data/rf_evals_all_horizons.csv")

```


```{r}
results_long <- bind_rows(rf_results_all)

# normalize names and ensure needed cols
results_long <- results_long %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# pivot: actual_{h} and predicted_{h}
results_wide <- results_long %>%
  select(date, horizon, actual, forecast) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = horizon,
              values_from = c(actual, forecast),
              names_glue = "{.value}_{horizon}") %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^forecast_", "predicted_", .x), starts_with("forecast_")) %>%
  arrange(date) %>% 
  slice(1:floor(0.8 * n))


# desired column order: date, actual_3m, predicted_3m, actual_6m, predicted_6m, actual_12m, predicted_12m
desired_order <- c("date", 
                   "actual_3m","predicted_3m",
                   "actual_6m","predicted_6m",
                   "actual_12m","predicted_12m")
cols_present <- intersect(desired_order, names(results_wide))
results_wide <- results_wide %>% select(all_of(cols_present), everything())

# save results
write_csv(results_wide, "../data/rf_train_predictions.csv")
```
